name: Aasra Welfare Association (NGO for RAG Pickers)
description:
“Aasra Welfare Association
is a non-profit organization in Mumbai providing dignified livelihoods for ex-waste scavengers at its inclusive waste management facilities. By purchasing waste from informal scavengers at fair prices and providing its workers with holistic welfare schemes, the organization works tirelessly to provide Aasra (“shelter” in Hindi) to hardworking yet stigmatized members of society.
A former scrap dealer with over 30 years of experience in Mumbai’s informal waste sector, our founder, Mr. Haider Ali witnessed first-hand the exploitation that waste scavengers face and has committed to use his deep knowledge of the sector towards providing them with aasra (“shelter”). “

name: Kherwadi Social Welfare Association
description: Kherwadi Social Welfare Association (KSWA) was founded in 1928 by Late Shri. B.G. Kher, a freedom fighter, statesman and the first Premier of Bombay State. He was moved by the plight and miserable living conditions of the 100 odd tanner families who had settled in the marshes of Bandra (E). While he was involved in the freedom struggle, leading two ministries in 1937 and 1946, interspersed with prison terms, his friends and associates started the Chamdewalla-ki-wadi in 1928 and continued to work in the area, which later came to be known as "Kherwadi".

owner_posts.post_text:
Yuva Parivartan wishes all fathers a very Happy Father’s Day.

Thank you to every father who encourages, supports, and inspires the next generation to learn, grow, and achieve their goals.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship Movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

Congratulations to 9 students from our Manipur RiseHY batch who have successfully joined Hyatt Regency Gurgaon to begin their hospitality careers.

This milestone reflects their hard work, dedication, and commitment to building a brighter future. We are proud to support young people on their journey from skills training to meaningful employment.

Wishing our students continued learning, growth, and success as they take this important step forward.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship Movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

AI is changing every industry. Are your skills keeping up?

At Yuva Parivartan, we've integrated a 20-Hour AI & Future Skills Module into our vocational training programs to help youth stay ready for the jobs of tomorrow.

Nursing, Fashion Designing, Tally, Beautician, Advance Excel and Tailoring students now gain practical exposure to AI-powered tools used in today's workplaces.

✅ Industry-Relevant Training
✅ AI & Future Skills Module
✅ Certification After Completion
✅ Career-Focused Learning

Future-ready skills. Better careers. Brighter futures.

Contact your nearest Yuva Parivartan centre to know more.

We are proud to share that The Kherwadi Social Welfare Association has been awarded the GuideStar India Platinum Certification, recognizing our commitment to transparency and public accountability.

This certification reflects our continuous efforts in delivering impactful programs focused on youth empowerment, skill development, and community upliftment.

We thank our team, partners and supporters for their ongoing trust and support in helping us create meaningful change.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship Movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

Avinash Kharvi from Andheri, Mumbai, completed his training at Yuva Parivartan and is now working at Novotel Mumbai International Airport.

Through focused training in communication, confidence, and workplace skills, he is gaining real experience in the hospitality industry and building a stable career.

At Yuva Parivartan, we help youth become job-ready through practical skill development and industry exposure.

Visit your nearest center to know more.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship Movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

Every opportunity to learn a skill is a chance to change a life.

Behind every trained electrician is a story of strength, someone who has moved from uncertainty to independence, from daily struggles to a steady income. Skill-based training not only creates job opportunities but also builds confidence, dignity and long-term stability for families.

By supporting initiatives like this, you contribute to more than just education. You help create livelihoods, strengthen communities, and support lasting change.

Even a small step like learning a skill can make a big difference. It can turn uncertainty into stability and open doors to new opportunities.

Let’s help more people take that step forward.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship Movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

Our Yuva Parivartan team recently participated in an engaging wellness session focused on understanding emotions and managing stress in healthier ways. Through simple activities and guided discussions, participants learned practical techniques to stay calm, aware and emotionally balanced in everyday life.

Such sessions remind us that empowering youth is not only about building skills for careers but also about strengthening their emotional well-being.

We thank Monica Karia and Akash Waghmare for sharing their valuable insights and guiding our learners toward greater emotional awareness and resilience.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship Movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

Celebrating Women’s Day at Yuva Parivartan!

The day was filled with fun team activities, games, laughter and wonderful moments of togetherness. It was a special opportunity to appreciate the incredible women of Yuva Parivartan whose dedication, strength and passion continue to inspire our work and impact communities across the country.

We are proud to celebrate the women who make our mission stronger every day.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

Remembering Balasaheb Gangadhar Kher on his Death Anniversary.

A respected freedom fighter and statesman, B. G. Kher made significant contributions to public service and governance in India. On this day, we pay tribute to his legacy and remember his dedication to the nation.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

📅 8 March 1957

Empowering Young Minds Through Financial Literacy & Career Guidance

Nearly 50 young participants gained practical knowledge on money management and career readiness during an engaging session led by dedicated volunteers from Avendus.

Through real-life insights, open discussions and actionable tools, the session helped build confidence and clarity about their financial and professional futures.

We sincerely thank the Avendus team for contributing their time and expertise to support youth development and strengthen our community’s future workforce.

Yuva Parivartan, A Flagship movement of Kherwadi Social Welfare Association.

featured_reviews.name: Dhruvi Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last week parked my car on the road next to other private cars and it happened to be right opposite Asif Bhamla's house where the Bhamla's Foundation office is there. Nobody objected nor was there any no parking board or any reserved private parking board. After a couple of hours when I come back I see that a Bhamla's Foundation van has double parked next to my car and the driver is missing. I asked around as I had to leave so one of the cafe's watchman pointed to the Bhamla House gate. I go in and the watchman decodec to call the driver as he was not around and then informs me that the driver will come in 5 mins.

Now the driver turns up after 15 mins on a bike. So he left his van and went on to do his work. When he came I told him this was so unfair that he double parks and abandons the car and to top it all he turns up at his own sweet time. He started shouting at me about how the Bhamla foundation owns 2 car parks across the road not even outside his building. And given the benefit of doubt they also might be owning them but there was no board or a sign that said so. He started shouting at me and started intimidating me. Asked me where in the lane I had gone? I said it doesn't matter where I go if it is your parking how is an ordinary civilian supposed to know .just keep a board so next time this doesn't happen .don't double park turn up after 15 mins and then shout at me. He was so angry that he had to leave his work get on a bike and come back to shift the van for me .

He started threatening me that every watchman in the lane knows that they own the parking and I shouldn't have . Nobody stopped me when I decided to park. If there is no board or a sign on a public road how is an ordinary citizen who is not from that area to know that a foundation across the road owns the parking. This was such a bad experience! Because it took me 10 mins to find out whose car it is and get in touch with the driver and another 15-20 mins waiting for him.

featured_reviews.name: 18 Vedprakash Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello everyone myself Dr. Vedprakash Dubey and I am deeply grateful to the Nargis Dutt Foundation for supporting me throughout my MBBS journey. Without their generous support, achieving my dream of becoming a doctor and earning the title of "Dr." before my name would have been extremely difficult.

I have often heard Priya Dutt Ma'am saying, "Every student here is my family" and after experiencing the love, care, and support of the Nargis Dutt Foundation over the years, I can truly say that I have felt it in every sense.💯❤️

What makes this foundation truly special is that their support goes far beyond financial assistance. They genuinely care about the student's mental well-being and treat us like family. Every staff member is incredibly cooperative, approachable, and always willing to help whenever needed.

The Foundation also organizes seminars and developmental programs that contribute to the holistic growth of students, helping us build confidence, communication skills, and overall personality development.

I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to all the donors and the entire team of the Nargis Dutt Foundation for their unwavering commitment to supporting students and helping cancer patients.

A special thank you to Priya Dutt Ma'am and Andrea Ma'am for their constant encouragement, motivation, and guidance. Your support has played a significant role in helping me complete my MBBS degree and fulfill my dream of becoming a doctor.

Thank you for transforming lives and creating opportunities for countless students like me. I will always remain grateful.🙏❤️

The foundation is making a real difference in the lives of students by providing financial assistance and encouragement to achieve their goals. I sincerely thank the entire team for their kindness, dedication, and commitment to empowering young talent.

Highly appreciated and highly recommended for the incredible work they do for society. Thank you for believing in students like me and helping us build a brighter future. 🙏❤️

— Arjun Gehlot

The financial assistance and guidance provided by the foundation helped me continue my studies and move closer to my career goals. I am truly thankful for their generosity, kindness, and dedication to helping students achieve their dreams.

Nargis Dutt Foundation is doing remarkable work for education and community welfare. I highly recommend their organization and sincerely appreciate the positive impact they have made in my life.

Thank you, Nargis Dutt Foundation, for your invaluable support.

featured_reviews.name: Waqar Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Nargis Dutt Foundation has been one of the biggest supporters in helping me continue my dream of pursuing an MBBS degree.
The way they welcome and greet every student is truly heartwarming. Most students are often scared and lack the confidence to express themselves, but the Foundation makes them feel comfortable and helps ease their concerns through counseling, guidance, and constant support.
Through NDF, every student gradually builds confidence and grows stronger. By the time they complete their course, they emerge as more confident, capable, and resilient individuals.
For me, NDF is like a second home. They have not only provided me with financial support but have also played a significant role in shaping my personality and helping me grow as a person.
Priya Dutt Ma'am is an incredibly kind and compassionate woman. She always encouraged me by saying, "I'm here for you. Just keep working hard—we are all here to support you." Those words gave me strength and motivation to keep moving forward.
I will always be grateful to the Nargis Dutt Foundation for believing in me and supporting me throughout my journey.

description: ACID SURVIVORS SAAHAS FOUNDATION Acid survivors saahas foundation was an initiative that was started in 2016 by Mrs Daulat Bi Khan. She herself was the casualty of acid attack in 2010. This attack was executed by her own elder sister and her husband and son due to some property disagreement. Today, I proudly participated in the Swachha Vasundhara Abhiyan at Carter Road 🌿

The programme aimed to encourage people, especially students and youth, to take responsibility for keeping our surroundings clean and green.
During the activity, we cleaned public areas, collected waste, and learned the importance of proper waste disposal and environmental conservation. The experience made me realize that small individual efforts can create a big positive impact on society and nature. featured_reviews.name: Aryan Biswas
featured_reviews.review_text: The Swachh Vasundra Abhiyan for removing plastic in Bandra West is a commendable environmental initiative that has positively influenced local cleanliness and public awareness. The campaign successfully mobilized residents, students, and volunteers, resulting in visible reduction of plastic waste in several public areas. Its awareness activities, including rallies and social media outreach, have helped educate citizens about the harmful effects of single-use plastic. However, the impact can be strengthened through more regular follow-up drives, better promotion of eco-friendly alternatives like cloth bags, and improved waste segregation at the source. Greater involvement of local shopkeepers and systematic tracking of the plastic collected would also enhance long-term effectiveness. Overall, the initiative is a strong step toward a cleaner and more sustainable Bandra West, with good potential to become a model for other urban neighborhoods if sustained consistently.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur kaskar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently participated in a mangrove clean-up drive organized by "Swachha Vasundhara Abhiyaan" at "Carter Road - Bandra", "Mumbai".

The experience was truly eye-opening. Seeing the amount of plastic and waste trapped in the mangroves was shocking — it took nearly 30 minutes to clean just one mangrove tree. It made us realize how much human activity is harming the very ecosystem that supports us.

We sincerely appreciate Rahul and his team for taking this meaningful initiative. True to their name, they are working hard to keep the environment clean and green. Kudos to the team for spreading awareness and actively protecting the mangroves, which are the guardians of our coastline.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Midday Meal is a strategic program of the Government of India, and is being implemented by Annamrita Foundation previously known as ISKCON Food Relief Foundation (IFRF) in select schools across the country. The aim of this project is to liberate children from the vicious cycle of Malnourishment and Illiteracy.

It is a not-for-profit, non-religious, non-sectarian public charitable organizations formed on April 23, 2004 and registered under the Bombay Public Trusts Act, 1950

“Annamrita” literally translated means “Food as Pure as Nectar”.

Annamrita believes in providing children with the right nutrition to support their education. Our program is based on the belief that ‘you are what you eat’. Therefore one nutritious meal prepared with compassion and love, the way a mother would prepare a meal for her child, brings thousands of children to school daily.

Annamrita Foundation serves over 1 million meals every single day, through its 20 kitchens across India. We have a presence in 7 states namely - Andhra Pradesh, Delhi, Haryana, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and West Bengal.

Our aim is to Promote Education One Meal at a Time by providing nutritious, wholesome, hygienic meals prepared in hi-tech kitchens which not only nourish the body but also nurture the soul.

✤Kshitij means ‘horizon’ in Hindi.A horizon for our wards to finally reach as they go through their challenging journeys of life. Founded in 1997 by 4 mothers of intellectually challenged adults, Kshitij is today a close-knit support network of families, staff members, therapists and volunteers.
✤As a Mumbai-based NGO, Kshitij provides a sheltered nurturing workplace to adults with intellectual disabilities such as Downs Syndrome, Autism and Brain Damage.
✤Limited awareness, expensive or inaccessible health care services and social stigma are some of the challenges faced by parents of children with special needs.
✤Delay in detection leads to delay in early intervention, an essential component for their key skills development.
